_source: mesnium-executive-brandbook-revised-v3.pdf (Executive Edition 1.0). Page numbers refer to that PDF. Values are copied from it verbatim; nothing here is invented.

crimson.role: Signature — one deliberate signal per composition

charcoal.role: Supporting — body copy on warm white

stone.role: Supporting — decorative, not small body text

semantic.rule: Pair every semantic colour with an icon and a written status.

productSurfaces._note: Dark-first. The brandbook and the product are both specified dark-first (page 41).

ratio.guidelineRange: Crimson should be 5-10% of a composition (page 37).

accessibility.focusRing: Crimson on light surfaces, warm white on dark surfaces.

families.technical: IBM Plex Mono — labels, metadata, timestamps and engineering detail. Never long passages.

rules: Display is for statements, not dashboards.
Keep body at normal tracking; reserve positive tracking for uppercase labels.
Use real weights; never artificially stretch or condense.

layout.elevation: Reserved for dialogs and floating controls: 0 8px 32px black at 8% (rgba(0,0,0,0.08)).

states.active: crimson icon on a pale crimson surface
states.never: Do not fill outline icons or change stroke weight to communicate state.

respond.use: Hover, press, selection. Colour or opacity only.

reveal.use: Panels arrive over 8px; the surrounding workspace stays still.

resolve.use: A progress fill connects work to its result. Complete once, then rest.

introduce.use: The intact symbol fades in; lettering follows after 80ms.

always: Name the current state in text — movement is never the message.
Respect reduced-motion preferences with the same static end state.

logo.files: apps/web/public/brand/ — extracted from the vector art on page 8 (symbol) and page 7 (lockup and DM Sans SemiBold wordmark).
rules: Use approved SVG artwork. Preserve proportion, clear space of one module, and minimum sizes.
Use the reverse mark on dark backgrounds.
Preserve the opening between the two forms, including in single colour.
Never change the spelling or separate the name into two words. Say MEZ-nee-um.

messagingTerritories.caveat: Validate legal availability before adopting a registered tagline.
